title: Ocean Numbers — Developing Challenge
subject: Math
learning_objective: Add and subtract within 10 using objects, drawings, or equations.
instructions: Use pictures or tally marks for each step.

story_content.opening: Willa the Whale paddles near a sunny reef. She wants to find a smooth stone.
story_content.passage: Willa looks under a flat rock. She finds three smooth stones. A crab scurries away. Willa keeps one stone for her collection. Then she swims back to the reef.
story_content.ending: Great work exploring ocean ideas today!
